action.sql: SELECT g.dept_id, SUM(g.debit - g.credit) AS operating_expense FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON g.account_id = a.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND g.period IN ('2026-04','2026-05','2026-06') AND a.type = 'Expense' AND g.account_id BETWEEN '6000' AND '6999' GROUP BY g.dept_id ORDER BY operating_expense DESC LIMIT 1
